text:
You need a backend developer who can write reliable APIs and support your team with backend work, and I can help with that.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building production web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. My focus is on building backend systems that are clean, maintainable, and straightforward for a team to extend.

One relevant project was a Tutor marketplace MVP for Brightpath Tutors. I built a two-sided marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons, and automatic tutor payouts using Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Stripe Connect, and Twilio Video. It was live in 11 weeks, supported 300 tutors, and reached $48k gross bookings in the first quarter. That project required careful API design, payment flows, and data handling across multiple user roles.

I also built a Clipboard sync browser extension for Clipboardly. It synced saved snippets across devices through a small Express API, using TypeScript, the Chrome Extensions API, Express, and MongoDB. The product reached 9k weekly active users and a 4.7 store rating, which reflects the reliability and responsiveness of the backend supporting it.

For your backend role, I can help design and write RESTful APIs, structure database interactions, and build the backend side of features in a way that is easy to maintain. I’m comfortable working across the stack, but I’m especially strong when the work involves API implementation, data modeling, and making sure the backend supports the product cleanly.

If you’re looking for someone who can jump into API writing and work collaboratively with your team, I’d be glad to help. What kind of APIs or backend endpoints do you need built first?
